metadata.description:
Here we have a compilation of all the singles I released between 2022 and 2023. I have presented them in the highest available quality for full-audiophile listening enjoyment. See if you can pick up on how my music has evolved over time!

Download Here: https://www.mediafire.com/file/wu4kaxtk2rzohyu/Singles_%282022-2023%29.zip/file
Listen On YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLrEjbe3Ag_K3VkX_RGt87NendBMdyTGT_
Listen On SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com/nsass/sets/nsass-singles-2022-2023
Listen On Internet Archive: https://archive.org/details/singles-2022-2023-nsass

TRACKLIST

01 - Down With The Town - A Tribute To T-Dub
02 - FIFA WORLD CUP 2022 - You Would Give Me Kiss If I Were On Soccer Team (Gröûp X - Cover)
03 - SP0T<L!T3 (N.SΔss Reanimation) ft. Alice
04 - Step Up (Linkin Park Cover)
05 - You Would Give Me Kiss If I Were On Soccer Team (Gröûp X Cover) ft. Lil’ Yaties
06 - Kurmitt
07 - Kurmitt [Ambient Version]
08 - Pizza Poteetza ft. Troo Stong
09 - How Soon Is Now (The Smiths Cover)
10 - Kurmitt (Live at Pinelands)
11 - Nimbus
12 - Stick N Move (Linkin Park Cover)
13 - Stick N Move (Linkin Park Cover) [ALTERNATE MIX]
14 - Down With The Town (2023 Remaster)
15 - Down With The Town (2023 Remaster) INSTRUMENTAL
16 - God Rest You Merry, Gentlemen (NSASS Remix)
17 - Down With The Town (Original Unaltered Vocal Sessions)

Credits

Songs 1, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 14, 15, 16 and 17 written by NSASS
Songs 2 and 5 written by Hashmeer Shashmeer and Group X - Arabian Rap Sensations. Song 5 additionally remixed by NSASS
Song 3 written by Alice Peralta and remixed by NSASS
Songs 4, 12 and 13 composed by Linkin Park and remixed by NSASS
Song 9 written by The Smiths & remixed by NSASS

Sample credits: Connor Terrones, and Purple and yellow beat up red among us

Guest Vocals: Troo Stong and Lil' Yaties
